QualityPage.title: Proof in Every Vial
QualityPage.subtitle: In the research industry, assumptions destroy data. We rely on strict analytical validation, ensuring every compound reaching your laboratory exceeds 99% purity. No exceptions.

pipeline.title: Our Analytical Pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: A rigorous sequence of synthesis, purification, and verification guarantees absolute sequence accuracy.

step1.title: 1. Production & Synthesis
step1.desc: Compounds are synthesized under strict cGMP-compliant conditions utilizing solid-phase peptide synthesis (SPPS), ensuring structural fidelity from the first amino acid chain.

step2.title: 2. Third-Party Testing
step2.desc: Samples are sent to independent US-based analytical laboratories for High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) and Mass Spectrometry (MS) to verify ≥99% purity.

step3.title: 3. Batch-Matched COA
step3.desc: A unique Certificate of Analysis is generated for each production batch. We do not use generic or outdated testing reports. What you see is exactly what is in your vial.
